versions.subject: Add registry_set_disable_winevt_logging
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|startswith: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WINEVT\Channels\
    TargetObject|endswith: \Enabled 
    Details: DWORD (0x00000000)
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\WINEVT\\Channels\\*" TargetObject="*\\Enabled" Details="DWORD (0x00000000)"

versions.subject: Channel disable during installation
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventType: SetValue
    TargetObject|startswith: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WINEVT\Channels\
    TargetObject|endswith: \Enabled 
    Details: DWORD (0x00000000)
filter:
    TargetObject|contains:
        - \WordChannel\
        - \General Logging\
        - \OfficeChannel\
        - \OfficeDebugChannel\
        - \AirSpaceChannel\
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventType="SetValue" TargetObject="HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\WINEVT\\Channels\\*" TargetObject="*\\Enabled" Details="DWORD (0x00000000)" NOT (TargetObject IN ("*\\WordChannel\\*", "*\\General Logging\\*", "*\\OfficeChannel\\*", "*\\OfficeDebugChannel\\*", "*\\AirSpaceChannel\\*"))
